instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page React application with React Router (Home, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Support/Contact).
Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling and Framer Motion for kinetic line-by-line reveals, scroll triggers, and tab transitions.
Apply the Light & Earthy palette consistently: Warm off-white background (#F9F7F1), deep forest green (#1E3A2B), wheat-gold highlights (#C89542).
Ensure Header navigation is sticky with crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F9F7F1]/85 border-b border-[#E2DDCF]/60). Never transparent.

Implement the 'Built for the paddock' benefits section as numbered manifesto chapters (01 Farm & paddock management, 02 Job planning & tracking, 03 Mapping & paddock boundaries, 04 Simple team visibility, 05 Works with real ag operations).
Implement realistic interactive mobile app screenshots placeholders with tabbed navigation (Paddock Map, Job Board, Team Activity, Equipment Sync) inside custom SVG mobile device mockups.
Include app store badges (iOS App Store & Google Play) styled cleanly in 'Beta / Launching Soon' state.
Build fully functional forms (Beta Interest Form on Home, Support Form on Support page) connected to Sonner toast notifications and form validation.
All interactive elements must carry proper data-testid attributes for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop centered layouts, plain white backgrounds, or default Vercel templates.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'. Always specify properties (e.g. 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease').
MUST NOT center align the main app container globally.
Always use modern pill-shaped or sharp tailored buttons with interactive hover/focus states.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for UI icons. Use Lucide icons or SVG vectors.
Use 2-3x generous spacing between sections (py-20 to py-32) for premium breathing room.
Add subtle noise overlays, grain textures, and custom border highlights to give the app a organic, physical touch.
